meaning:
1) to start up, tremble, shake, spring up
1a) (Qal) to start up
1b) (Piel) to leap
1c) (Hiphil) to cause to start up

elsewhere.note: Yet you may eat these: of all winged creeping things that go on all fours, which have long, jointed legs for hopping on the earth.
God is my strong fortress. He makes my way perfect.
even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!
The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.
“Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to release the bonds of wickedness, to undo the straps of the yoke, to let the oppressed go free, and that you break…
He stood, and shook the earth. He looked, and made the nations tremble. The ancient mountains were crumbled. The age-old hills collapsed. His ways are eternal.
